a: `set-overlays` takes any key, so `{ highlight: true }` lands in the canvas's debug config and makes the debug sink throw
A removed root keeps the panel's overlay and highlight override on its canvas
The page accepts a `yo` and requests from any frame, so another origin's iframe can connect and steer the canvas
An emptied override still forces the debug overlay on until the panel closes
A root keeps the trace, coords and history rings it first saw, while its getters read the current dep
A root's `dimension` is reported once, from the first root node at register time, so a 3D canvas that mounts empty is listed as 2d
`connect` keeps listening on the transport after the panel says `bye`
`serialize` writes Errors, RegExps, DataViews, ArrayBuffers, DOM nodes and similar built-ins as a bare `{}`
b: `set-overlays` accepts any boolean-valued key, so `{ highlight: true }` reaches the debug sink as a non-array and throws
A root's override is never cleared when the root is unregistered while its canvas stays mounted
The window hook accepts a `yo` from any frame, so an embedded iframe can take over (and disconnect) the extension's session
A 3D canvas whose scene is empty when it registers is announced, and stays, `'2d'`
The history ring is not reset when the canvas's scene is swapped, so `get-history` mixes the old scene's steps with the new scene's position
`serialize` writes an Error, RegExp, ArrayBuffer, DataView, WeakMap, Promise and similar built-ins as `{}`, contrary to its contract
